evals.prompt: I need to design a database for a task management system. Users can create projects, each project has multiple tasks, tasks can be assigned to users, and tasks have comments. Users belong to teams. I need the full PostgreSQL schema.
evals.expected_output: Mermaid ER diagram + PostgreSQL DDL with all mandatory columns (id identity PK, timestamps, audit user columns on user-facing tables), triggers, proper naming conventions, FK constraints without CASCADE, FILLFACTOR on all objects.

evals.prompt: Add a tags feature to this table. Tags are shared across the system (not per-project). Tasks can have multiple tags. I need the PostgreSQL DDL for the new tables and any ALTER statements needed. The existing task table uses int4 id with identity.
evals.expected_output: A tag table and task_tag junction table with proper naming, mandatory columns (id, timestamps), FK constraints using RESTRICT only, proper junction table naming convention, FILLFACTOR, triggers.

evals.prompt: I have a PostgreSQL audit_log table that gets about 500K inserts per day. It has columns: id, user_id, action, entity_type, entity_id, details (jsonb), created_at_timestamp. Design the table with partitioning, proper indexes, and make sure it follows all our conventions. Also give me the SQL Server equivalent.
evals.expected_output: Both PostgreSQL and SQL Server DDL. PostgreSQL with declarative monthly partitioning, int8 PK (high volume), jsonb with default, indexes with high-cardinality columns first. SQL Server with nvarchar, partition function/scheme, datetime2. Both with mandatory columns, triggers, FILLFACTOR, proper naming.
